description: In server.rs, run_server has two large select! arms that are nearly identical — one for the case where a SMTPS listener is present and one for the case where it is absent. The accept logic, semaphore acquire, connection dispatch, and error handling are copy-pasted. This creates a maintenance burden: any change to accept handling must be made in two places. Fix: wrap the optional SMTPS listener in a future that resolves to Never when absent (e.g. using futures::future::pending()), so the select! can always have both arms without duplication.
title: smtp: server.rs duplicates select! branches for with/without SMTPS
